description: handle_mdn_send builds sent_creation_ids: Vec<String> by pushing creation IDs as MDNs are added to sent_mdns: HashMap<String, Mdn>. The vec is then used only for sent_creation_ids.is_empty() and for creation_id_str in &sent_creation_ids. Both of these uses are fully covered by sent_mdns.is_empty() and for creation_id_str in sent_mdns.keys(). The extra Vec allocation is unnecessary. Fix: remove sent_creation_ids; replace the two uses with sent_mdns equivalents.
title: Redundant sent_creation_ids Vec in handle_mdn_send
